title.zh: 【Mesh 与 Visa 达成合作，实现加密货币余额直接消费】
title.en: 【Mesh 与 Visa 达成合作，实现加密货币余额直接消费】

current_state.zh: Mesh has partnered with Visa to let users spend cryptocurrency, stablecoin, and fiat wallet balances directly at Visa merchants, with Mesh generating Visa payment credentials and handling KYC and back-end asset conversion.
